School admin · job sample · Flask SSR

One product story: weekly loop + timetable ops + rosters

An international-high-school admin web app: role-based weekly feedback loop + timetable operations + administrative rosters, with exams/homework as the academic side wing. Anonymised screenshots only — no production database.

Stack: Flask SSR · SQLite · roles (subject teacher / homeroom / admin). Web first; WeChat mini program is a channel note only (not built in this repo).

A week in the system

The thirty-second path: Fill → Chase → Adjust → Manage → Count & trail. Exams/homework are side wings; the mini program is channel-only.

Fill → Chase → Adjust → Manage → Count & trail

  1. Fill — Subject teachers record the week by class: batch fill, copy last week, fold columns, presets.
  2. Chase — Homeroom sees missing subjects and students to watch, then routes chase chips to teachers.
  3. Adjust — Request moves/cancels/covers/add-ons on the timetable; admins approve or apply now.
  4. Manage — Students · classes · teaching assignments stay aligned as the data triangle.
  5. Count & trail — Hours roll up by week; print/CSV writes an export audit log.

Modules 01–06

Numbered by complete admin jobs, not PR changelogs. Moral-education is not shipped; a scheduler ≠ timetable operations.

01

Weekly feedback fill-in

Subject-teacher path: filter class and students, Excel-style batch fill, fold secondary columns, apply multi-field presets; print and CSV.

02

Homeroom overview & chase-up

Missing-subject KPIs, students to watch, and chase chips; class print and chase CSV.

03

Timetable ops & change requests

Timetable operations loop: request → approve/apply-now → add-on/cancel. Not a campus-wide visual scheduler; initial cells are mostly imported.

04

Administrative rosters

Students, classes and teaching assignments form the data triangle; soft-deactivate, teachable subjects and proxy views included. Enrolment vs assignment sync remains an ops concern.

05

Exams & homework

Academic side wing: exam registration and homework set/record/student file are live; weekly-test sync is off; auto-grading is not merged.

Screenshot gap: exam/homework pages still need local init_db --demo captures (never production). Copy-only for now.

06

Hours & export audit

Hours roll up from the current timetable and temp add-ons; teacher/homeroom print and CSV leave an export log for traceability.
